newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Sunday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.

Turnover fell sharply to 1.7 billion yuan from 2.916 billion yuan on Wednesday with the seven-day contract the most actively traded. The market was closed from Thursday to Saturday for the Labour Day holiday.
Trading was slow mainly because China's securities markets were closed on Sunday, removing a major source of fund demand on the interbank market, traders said.
"Securities houses did not trade today with the securities markets all closed," said one trader.
Traders said they expected trading to be more active on Monday with the interbank rates moving in a narrow range.
